# Feature: Run detail findings

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #24 -->

## Intent
Finding Detail has six fixed blocks (PRD §10): observed, budget/baseline, when in the scenario, signals/sources, change class, verification. Overview shows quality and budgets, never a single score. A golden-artifact run is readable in the UI including ruleId and confidence.

## Preconditions
- Dashboard shell and live run (#21, #23)
- Golden artifact fixture (#9)
- Evidence graph (#8)

## Happy Path
- [x] Overview contains run quality and budget-status categories, no overall performance score
- [x] Finding Detail renders the six PRD blocks including ruleId and confidence
- [x] Status is never color-only (text or icon+text)
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] Low confidence is shown as low, not upgraded
- [x] Pass / fail / inconclusive use icon and text
- [x] Source URIs outside a relative allowlist are not rendered
- [x] Missing artifact → empty/error with next action, not a fake score

## Regression
- [ ] Live run / abort still work
- [ ] Token not in localStorage
- [ ] Scope: dashboard run detail + local-api artifact GET — no Compare table

## Assumptions
- The committed golden `01J9GOLDENV100000000000000` is the readable run for this slice
- Budget categories without a metric are inconclusive (measurement may still be listed)
- UI copy is English
- Raw JSON tab may be a stub

## Security Coverage
- F-02: source URIs filtered to relative paths without `..`
- F-03: token stays in memory
- B-03: artifact GET requires the run token
- P-04 analog: runId allowlist unchanged
- F-01 waived (loopback)

## Implementation Notes
- Local API: `GET /api/v1/runs/:id/artifact` serves the committed golden fixture for `01J9GOLDENV100000000000000` after `runArtifactSchema.parse`. Same id is readable via `GET /api/v1/runs/:id` when not in the in-memory map. Invalid run ids still 400.
- Dashboard `/runs/:id`: tabs Overview / Findings / Raw stub. Overview: quality from status (completed → Valid) plus five budget cards (all Inconclusive without budgets; `frame_time_*` listed under Rendering). Findings: table + six PRD blocks. Confidence is copied from the artifact. Source URIs must be relative without `..` or a scheme.
- Dashboard does not depend on `@potato-boost/schemas`; thin view types + a type-guard parser. Token remains memory-only.
- Tests: local-api golden GET + 400 on encoded `../` runId; FindingDetail six headings; low confidence stays low; no "Performance Score".

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: open completed run → GET artifact → overview + N finding blocks (no invented score).
- N-actors: one artifact yields N findings; UI does not collapse them into a Performance Score.
- Invalid: unknown runId 404 empty; traversal runId 400; source URIs with `..` or a scheme are not rendered.
- Two consumers: GET is read-only; no write fan-out.
- Skip reason: n/a
